report:
Skin, dorsum of right hand, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. The dermis contains histiocytes palisading around foci of altered collagen, with increased central mucin. Alcian blue stain shows increased dermal mucin. The overall features are those of granuloma annulare. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, dorsum of right hand, punch biopsy - GRANULOMA ANNULARE
